component.name: aprende
component.summary: Learn difficult things with a tutor that runs on your own Claude or Codex

description.p: aprende is an open-source desktop app for learning difficult things. A tutor finds where your understanding ends, maps a path to your goal, and teaches one reasoning step at a time. It runs the claude or codex CLI you already have, with your own login.
aprende is a fork of T3 Code (https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code, MIT) and is not affiliated with T3 Tools Inc.
